rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a firearm, especially an individual gun.

example.english: Someone saw a firearm near his home, so the whole street was sealed off.
example.traditional: 佢屋企附近有人見到一支槍，搞到成條街都封咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 jan4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zi1 coeng1 gaau2 dou3 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 fung1 zo2

rows.note: Use this more formal term in legal, official, or technical contexts referring to firearms generally.

example.english: The police are investigating a case of illegal firearm possession.
example.traditional: 警方正調查非法管有槍械嘅案件。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zing3 tiu4 caa4 fei1 faat3 gun2 jau5 coeng1 haai6 ge3 on3 gin6
